title: Words to World: Benchmarking LLMs in Interactive Physical Environments
abstract: arXiv:2610.15228v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Words are increasingly becoming an interface for action: large language models (LLMs) can now invoke tools, operate devices, and make decisions that affect the physical world. However, current benchmarks largely evaluate LLMs through static text responses, offline tool calls, or simulated tasks, leaving open the question of how well they can act in real physical environments. We present a benchmark for measuring LLMs in closed-loop physical interaction, where models control a harness system connected to real-world components including robotic arms, cameras, and sensors. In each task, the model must issue instructions, receive physical feedback from the environment, interpret the resulting state, and adapt its next action accordingly. This setting evaluates capabilities beyond language understanding, including grounded perception, action planning, tool selection, spatial reasoning, feedback-driven correction, and robustness to execution u

translated_title: 从词语到世界：在交互式物理环境中对大语言模型进行基准测试
translated_abstract: 词语正日益成为行动的接口：大语言模型（LLMs）如今可以调用工具、操作设备，并做出影响物理世界的决策。然而，目前的基准测试大多通过静态文本回答、离线工具调用或模拟任务来评估LLMs，这留下了一个悬而未决的问题：它们在真实物理环境中的行动能力究竟如何。我们提出了一个用于衡量LLMs在闭环物理交互中表现的基准测试，其中模型控制一个连接到真实世界组件的线束系统，这些组件包括机械臂、摄像头和传感器。在每项任务中，模型必须发出指令、从环境接收物理反馈、解读由此产生的状态，并相应地调整其下一步行动。这一设置评估了超越语言理解的能力，包括基于实感的感知、行动规划、工具选择、空间推理、基于反馈的纠错，以及对执行不确定性的鲁棒性。
tldr: 该论文提出了首个让大语言模型在闭环真实物理环境中行动的基准测试，通过控制连接机械臂、摄像头和传感器的线束系统，考察其感知、规划、工具选择与反馈纠错等超越纯语言理解的能力。
en_tdlr: This paper presents a benchmark for evaluating LLMs in closed-loop real-world physical interaction, where models control a harness system connected to robotic arms, cameras, and sensors, assessing capabilities beyond language understanding such as grounded perception, action planning, tool selection, and feedback-driven correction.
